items.title: Frank Alkyer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Orleans, Louisiana, January 10, 2020
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...titles, like: “Dorsey Hires New Canary.” ... [INTERVIEWEE] Orks, yeah, O-R-K.

ctx.x: journalists, they were musicians mostly. They were cantankerous, they were, you know it was, there was some funny stuff that would go on. And I wish that we could do some of that. And sometimes we try to get an element of it, but we just can’t be quite that freewheeling when you’re 85 years old and you’ve been around for all this time. We have a little bit more weight and gravitas that we need to present in the magazine, so —

Plus those big bands provided such drama. I have some from the mid-40s and first of all the look of them is just so wonderful. But these titles, like: “Dorsey Hires New Canary.” And the language. And the orks, they called them orks for orchestra.
